body:
Found while running the gate after the packaging work landed. The new wheel-build stage uses `pip wheel --no-build-isolation`, which needs setuptools inside `server/.venv`. It is now a pinned dev dependency, so a fresh `bootstrap.sh` checkout has it — but an EXISTING checkout whose venv predates that pin does not, and the stage fails with a raw `BackendUnavailable: Cannot import 'setuptools.build_meta'` traceback that says nothing about what to do. I hit exactly this on the main checkout.

Fix: have build-wheel.sh check for an importable setuptools first and fail with the actual instruction (`cd server && .venv/bin/pip install -e ".[dev]"`), the way verify-all.sh's android_preflight explains its own missing pieces. Worth checking the same for anything else the gate's newer stages assume is installed.
title: build-wheel.sh: an out-of-date venv fails with a raw traceback instead of what to do
